data.name: Maulidah
data.gender_notes: Maulidah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name that signifies the celebration of the birth of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). The name Maulidah carries the meaning “Birth of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh)” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Maulidah usually hope their child will grow to embody birth of prophet muhammad (pbuh) and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Remembrance of the Prophet's (pbuh) blessed birth
data.etymology: Maulidah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Birth of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh).”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Maulidah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: The annual commemoration of Maulidah (Prophet Muhammad's birthday) is a significant cultural tradition in the Islamic world. It is a time when Muslims come together to honor the life and legacy of their prophet. This occasion is marked by various activities, including recitation of Hadiths and Quran, communal prayers, and feasts. Additionally, it is common to adorn mosques and homes with decorative lights, and for children to dress up in traditional Islamic clothing. Maulidah serves as a reminder of the unity and rich cultural heritage of the Muslim community.
data.spiritual_significance: The observance of Maulidah holds immense spiritual significance for Muslims. It is believed that by commemorating the birth of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), one can draw closer to Allah. Through the recitation of beautiful praises and invocations, known as "Mawlid" poetry, and gaining knowledge about his life and teachings, Muslims strive to emulate the character and actions of the Prophet. Furthermore, this celebration is an opportunity to seek Allah's forgiveness and give thanks for the blessings bestowed upon us. Thus, Maulidah serves as a means for spiritual upliftment and growth for the believers.
